_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/triggers/test_trigger_doubling.py. t_prodigy scopes by the SUBTYPE of the permanent whose ability fired (Harmonic Prodigy); t_veyran scopes by the CAUSE being a spell you cast or copied (Veyran, Voice of Duality). Two axes, one static effect. t_upkeep_wizard GAINS LIFE rather than drawing: the upkeep window is one step away from the turn's own draw, and a life total cannot be confused with it.

cards.name: Test Harmonic Prodigy
cards.oracle_text: If a triggered ability of a Shaman or another Wizard you control triggers, that ability triggers an additional time.

abilities.text: If a triggered ability of a Shaman or another Wizard you control triggers, that ability triggers an additional time.

cards.name: Test Veyran
cards.oracle_text: If you casting or copying an instant or sorcery spell causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.

abilities.text: If you casting or copying an instant or sorcery spell causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
